subtitle: 레이트 체크아웃 · 문장별 음성 재생

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Good morning. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Hi. Would it be possible to have a late check-out today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Would it be possible to stay until two o'clock?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Let me check. Yes, we can do two o'clock for you.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Thank you. And would it be possible to leave my luggage here until then?
turns.ko: 감사합니다. 그때까지 짐을 여기에 맡겨도 될까요?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Of course. You can leave it at the front desk.
turns.ko: 물론이죠. 프런트 데스크에 맡기실 수 있습니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Perfect. Would it be possible to get two extra bottles of water as well?
turns.ko: 완벽합니다. 물 두 병 더 부탁해도 될까요?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.en: Sure. I'll send them up to your room.
turns.ko: 다 왔습니다. 네. 방으로 올려 드리겠습니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: That's very kind of you. Thank you so much.

desc: Would it be possible로 레이트 체크아웃·짐 보관 요청할 때
